status: FLAGGED — C1 FLOOR REACHABILITY IS CONVENTION-DEPENDENT (DIRECTED ROW VS UNDIRECTED RELATION); C2/C8 COMPETENCE CONDITIONAL

c1_ceiling.proof: C1's denominator is the count of paired-control available rows across every target and non-target row in the stream. Target selection only partitions those rows; it cannot add available rows. The largest denominator any target selection can produce is therefore min(A_available, K_available) for the stream.

candidate_stream.conclusion: Every seed's maximum is below the 60-row floor. The current candidate stream is not C1-capable, even if every candidate is selected and every available row is retained. This is a branch-closing result for target selection on this stream.

cell_stream.conclusion: The 112-row cell stream reaches 60 on four seeds, but that is reverse-orientation duplication rather than a wider independent universe. On unique undirected edges the C1 ceiling remains 31-44, below 60 on every seed. Switching to it also changes the C4 stream to 108/92 directed rows, or 59-60/43-44 unique non-target rows.

stream_composition.conclusion: The 112-row cell stream is the candidate stream plus its reverse orientations, not a wider independent universe. Availability is orientation-specific, so those reverse rows are not copies of the candidate rows' availability, but whether two orientations of one relation are independent C1 observations is a convention the protocol does not fix. Counting each relation once leaves the ceiling below the floor on every seed (see denominator_reconciliation).

c1_ceiling.conclusion: The current registered design is not C1-capable on the candidate stream under any reading. On the cell stream it clears the floor only if every directed orientation counts as its own row; counting undirected relations once does not clear it. That choice is recorded, not made, in denominator_reconciliation.
c1_ceiling.what_it_does_not_mean: This does not establish that A1 is impossible in principle. A different universe, seed block or C1 estimator could satisfy the floor. It establishes that the current stream and floor cannot be reconciled by selecting a different target block.

denominator_reconciliation.finding: On 2074 the two readings of the same word separate: directed rows give ceilings 64-79 and clear the floor on 6 of 6 seeds; undirected relations give 35-51 (any orientation) or 31-38 (both orientations) and clear it on 0 of 6. The orientations are not copies — A availability differs across orientations on 15-28 of 64 relations per seed — so the choice changes both the denominator and how many independent observations stand behind it. On 2063 the same split already exists: directed rows clear the floor on 4 of 6 seeds (70/59/69/58/72/72) and both relation readings clear it on none (31-46 and 28-42).

original_reading.label: the recorded reading of 2026-11-14
original_reading.status: FLAGGED — C1 CEILING BELOW FLOOR; C2/C8 TARGET COMPETENCE CONDITIONAL
original_reading.disposition: Do not freeze or run the current A1 design on these records. C1 is not target-selectable, and target competence requires an owner rule. A1 must be redesigned with a C1-capable universe or seed block and a pre-registered competence rule, or parked. No cell, target freeze, grant or threshold change is authorised.
original_reading.basis: the candidate stream's maximum attainable count, i.e. the 63-64 planning quantity
original_reading.preserved_because: It is the relation-level reading of C1's denominator, and this edition does not declare it wrong: it is the correct reading if a C1 row is one undirected relation. It is kept verbatim so the owner can see what was recorded before the convention question had a name.
original_reading.still_stands: The C2/C8 competence condition is untouched and remains scoped to the 2063 block.

denominator_reconciliation.what_this_does_not_mean: This does not make C1 pass or fail. Neither reading has been scored — no cell ran — and the floor applies to observed paired-control rows at run time. It does not revise the C2/C8 competence condition and does not decide which reading governs: that is an owner definition.

c2_c8_competence.status: CONDITIONAL — NOT A PROOF OF C2 OR C8 FAILURE
c2_c8_competence.assumption: This section treats baseline A and K availability as a precondition for a clean C2 row and a clean C8 double block. Under that target-competence reading, a row lacking baseline A or K cannot support all of C2's cells and cannot test a genuine A-K- double block.
c2_c8_competence.induction_caveat: C2 is a treatment gate, not a no-arm gate. The no-arm baseline cannot prove that a missing baseline path remains missing under A- or K+ treatment. If the unblocked arm can induce the absent path, exact C2 remains unmeasured. The counts are a conditional target-selection incompatibility, not a proof that C2 or C8 must fail.
c2_c8_competence.relationship: A1-TARGET-VIABILITY-1 reports carrier-missing exposure under the same baseline A/K reading. This report makes that reading explicit and does not treat it as proof of treatment failure.

target_pool.conclusion: The candidate pool contains 23-36 A&K-available edges per seed, enough to construct a 20-row competent block on all six seeds. The current N20 selection has only 5-12 clean rows, so the current C2/C8 problem is a selection problem, not a supply problem. C1 is still not repaired: its full-stream K availability is 31-44.

c2_c8_competence.conclusion: Under the stated competence reading, N4 has at most 3 clean rows per seed for a 4-row block and N20 has at most 12 for a 20-row block. Neither current target set supplies a clean C8 block. The candidate pool has 23-36 A&K-available edges, so a 20-row competent block is constructible by a new selection rule; the current N20 selection, not the supply, is the C2/C8 problem. C1 remains unresolved. Exact C2/C8 adjudication still requires cells or a pre-registered competence filter; the current data do not prove treatment failure.

disposition: Do not freeze or run the current A1 design on these records. C1 is not target-selectable, and target competence requires an owner rule. A1 must be redesigned with a C1-capable universe or seed block and a pre-registered competence rule, or parked. No cell, target freeze, grant or threshold change is authorised. C1 floor reachability is additionally convention-dependent: on 2074 directed rows clear the floor and undirected relations do not, and the protocol does not say which a C1 row is.
not_evidence: A read-only design-viability report over committed no-arm artifacts. It runs no A1 cell, freezes no target, changes no threshold and measures no treatment effect. The C2/C8 section is conditional on baseline target competence, not a C2 or C8 verdict.
